Treasure chests lie in many hunting grounds, but next to every real chest waits a mimic, and the two look exactly alike.

A real chest is opened with a key or an unlocking skill, and gives crafting materials - common, rare or epic. If you strike a real chest, it vanishes with its treasure.

A mimic attacks whoever tries to open it or hits it, curses them with debuffs and chases them a long way.

Tip: never hit a chest. Try a key on it: a real chest opens, a mimic reveals itself.
